en: Sepia photograph mounted on a card border, showing a street parade of girls in elaborate traditional folk costumes with floral headpieces and embroidered bodices. They walk along a decorated street lined with multi‑story buildings whose windows are draped with garlands. Crowds watch from the sidewalks and windows. At the bottom margin, a caption in German identifies the scene.
